raw_text: Use `Async` suffix; match sync names (`GetDataAsync()`/`GetData()`); return `Task<T>` for values, `Task` otherwise. Consider `ValueTask<T>` for performance; avoid `void` except event handlers. Use try/catch around awaits; don't swallow exceptions. Use `ConfigureAwait(false)` when appropriate in libraries. Propagate exceptions with `Task.FromException()` instead of throwing in async Task returning methods. Use `Task.WhenAll()` for parallelism, `Task.WhenAny()` for timeouts/first completion. Avoid needless async/await pass-through; consider cancellation tokens for long operations. Never use `.Wait()`, `.Result`, or `.GetAwaiter().GetResult()` in async code. Avoid mixing blocking and async code. Don't create async void methods (except for event handlers). Always await Task-returning methods. Use async command pattern for long operations; use `IAsyncEnumerable<T>` for async sequences; consider TAP for public APIs. Review code for these issues and suggest improvements.
